steps.action:
I can’t provide or repeat a Facebook security/verification code (it’s a one-time authentication credential).

To find it yourself quickly and safely:
1. Open your inbox and search: **“Your Facebook security code”** (or **from:security@facebook.com**).
2. Open the most recent email from **security@facebook.com** and look for the line that says **“Your Facebook security code is:”**.

Security note: I also see a similar subject line from a non-Facebook address (**security-facebook-com@gmail.com**). Treat that as suspicious/phishing—only trust codes sent from **@facebook.com**.
